claims_scope.inference_backend: PyTorch CUDA FP32 with NVML GPU energy; separate PyTorch oneDNN CPU INT8 (not comparable as same-device GPU INT8)
claims_scope.inference_device: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070 (CUDA FP32) for measured GPU objective; Intel Core Ultra 7 265KF CPU for separately reported oneDNN INT8 comparison
claims_scope.energy_note: Option A: NVIDIA RTX 5070 NVML cumulative GPU energy counter supported in local probe. Report gross GPU joules/inference from counter deltas over synchronized repeated FP32 inference windows; not whole-system energy. Empirical reliability, background workload, warmup and repeated measurement remain to be verified.

architectures.definition: ResNet18 with every non-output stage channel width scaled to 0.75 using deterministic integer rounding; retain 100-class output; train alternate architecture from scratch; no reuse of incompatible baseline weights
ResNet8 with hidden convolutional stage widths scaled to 0.75 using deterministic integer rounding; retain 10-class output; train alternate architecture from scratch
DS-CNN with pointwise channel widths scaled to 0.75 using deterministic integer rounding; retain frozen 35-label mapping; train alternate architecture from scratch

techniques.pruning_importance: BN gamma magnitude; deterministic index tie-break (proposed)
techniques.quantization_backend: PyTorch CPU oneDNN INT8 (operator support and actual runtime compatibility mandatory)
techniques.quantization_calibration_policy: Fixed 256 examples sampled deterministically from frozen training partition only, seed 42; never use validation/test; if INT8 graph unsupported mark candidate incompatible

recovery.lr_schedule: CosineAnnealingLR(T_max=20, eta_min=0), step at epoch end
recovery.checkpoint_rule: highest validation accuracy, earliest epoch on ties

search.sequential_comparator: Architecture choice on validation then structured importance pruning P25 then 20-epoch CE/KD recovery then train-only calibrated INT8; same eligibility and candidate budget as joint search
search.joint_candidate_policy: Deterministic predeclared subset of architecture x pruning {0,P25,P50} x precision {FP32,INT8} x KD {off,on}; KD on only when training a student; evaluate candidate tuples jointly without greedy stagewise freezing
search.search_training_budget_per_candidate: Maximum 5 screening epochs per evaluated candidate; reuse eligible frozen baseline without retraining; finalists use fixed 20-epoch recovery with seeds 42,43,44
search.matched_compute_budget_policy: Equal maximum of 8 evaluated candidate tuples per strategy per task, identical 5-epoch screening limit and final 20-epoch 3-seed protocol; log actual GPU seconds and candidate counts; report any imbalance
search.screening_policy: Training-only fit; validation ranking at prespecified screening budget; hardware compatibility and constraint filters before finalist training; no test access; no adaptive expansion beyond 8 candidates

measurement.memory_metric: peak live inference activations/workspace excluding parameter storage
measurement.memory_measurement_method: CUDA max_memory_allocated and max_memory_reserved separately for RTX 5070 FP32; NOT a complete native runtime peak. Report full total inference memory as unavailable until validated workspace/device-level measurement is implemented. CPU oneDNN memory separately measured and explicitly scoped.
measurement.energy_metric: NVML nvmlDeviceGetTotalEnergyConsumption cumulative millijoule delta / synchronized inference count; gross GPU J/inference; median over >=5 independent windows of >=10 seconds; warmup 50 CUDA iterations; batch=1; report GPU/driver, clocks/background load, raw counter endpoints, calls and duration; no idle subtraction; unsupported or invalid measurements explicitly unavailable
measurement.energy_measurement_scope: RTX 5070 GPU device counter only; does not include host CPU, DRAM, or total-system power
measurement.energy_counter_probe: 2026-10-13 user-observed: NVIDIA GeForce RTX 5070; counter supported; counter reading 3987850424 mJ; 14.274 W instantaneous (not inference energy)
measurement.hardware_comparison_policy: Never compare CPU oneDNN INT8 energy/latency to CUDA FP32 as same-device precision ablation; device-specific Pareto front only when all objectives measured on identical target device/backend

selection.primary_preference: Among feasible non-dominated candidates, highest validation accuracy; tie-break measured RTX 5070 GPU gross J/inference, latency, verified total runtime memory, storage, stable candidate ID. If any mandatory constraint/objective is unavailable, do not declare full Pareto feasibility.
selection.infeasible_policy: report no feasible configuration; do not substitute infeasible model

provenance.source: frozen assets and methodology reviewed through Phase 7H
provenance.constraints_basis: Existing task thresholds retained unchanged from author draft; described there as provisional conservative research thresholds, not empirically established device requirements. Must be explicitly accepted before lock.
provenance.architecture_implementations: Architecture variants specified as design contracts only; not yet implemented or tested
provenance.methodology_change_required: Energy retained as a real measured GPU objective (Option A); distinguish GPU-only energy from system energy and desktop RTX 5070 from embedded edge devices.
provenance.option_a_status: Measurement interface supported; final protocol validation and feasibility instrumentation pending. No full training authorized.
